stemMd: What does the cafés’ experience suggest?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Benefits of the changed event extended beyond the market stalls.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The new schedule benefited all businesses equally.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Visitors bought nothing anywhere in town.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Cafés caused the original afternoon market to fail.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Every stallholder also owned a café.

explanationMd: Nearby cafés reported busier evenings while stalls saw modest sales growth. The event’s economic effects therefore need not be confined to stallholders. The text does not establish identical gains or causal details for every business.

distractorRationale.d: The original market is not described as a failure.
distractorRationale.c: Busier cafés suggest activity outside stalls.
distractorRationale.b: The passage explicitly questions equal benefits.
